SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO

CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_RELATEDCUSTOMERACCOUNT_MBK] AS
BEGIN
---------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomerAccount
AS(
	SELECT
	 BMR.CUST_ACCT_ENROLLMENT_ID AS CustomerAccountId
	,BMR.ACCT_NO AS RelatedCustomerAccountId
	,'Linked FCBS Account' AS CustomerAccountRelationshipTypeId
	,BMR.CREATED_DATE AS PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,BMR.CIF_NO AS CustomerId
	,BMR.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,'MBK' AS SourceSystemCode
	,BMR.INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM BUSC.MBK_RTBKCUSTENROLLMENTMTB BMR
WHERE BMR.ISLATEST = 1
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomerAccount FROM TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomerAccount;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomerAccount_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerAccountId)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,RelatedCustomerAccountId)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerAccountRelationshipTypeId)
--,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, RelatedCustomerAccountId, CustomerAccountRelationshipTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode --,CustomerId
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomerAccount 
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomerAccount_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerAccountId)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,RelatedCustomerAccountId)
,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerAccountRelationshipTypeId)
--,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CustomerId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, RelatedCustomerAccountId, CustomerAccountRelationshipTypeId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode --,CustomerId
FROM BNKM.RelatedCustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'TRU' AND PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomerAccount_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
	,ISNULL(SRC.RelatedCustomerAccountId,TGT.RelatedCustomerAccountId) AS RelatedCustomerAccountId
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountRelationshipTypeId,TGT.CustomerAccountRelationshipTypeId) AS CustomerAccountRelationshipTypeId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomerAccount_SRC	SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomerAccount_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND	SRC.RelatedCustomerAccountId = TGT.RelatedCustomerAccountId
AND	SRC.CustomerAccountRelationshipTypeId = TGT.CustomerAccountRelationshipTypeId
AND	SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND	SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomerAccount_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomerAccount_DELTA;

-----UPDATE TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp))
FROM BNKM.RelatedCustomerAccount TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomerAccount_DELTA DELTA
 ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId  
 AND DELTA.RelatedCustomerAccountId = TGT.RelatedCustomerAccountId
 AND DELTA.CustomerAccountRelationshipTypeId = TGT.CustomerAccountRelationshipTypeId  
 AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId  
 AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode  
 AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomerAccount SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
AND SRC.RelatedCustomerAccountId = TGT.RelatedCustomerAccountId
AND SRC.CustomerAccountRelationshipTypeId = TGT.CustomerAccountRelationshipTypeId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL;




-----------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.RelatedCustomerAccount ( 
CustomerAccountId
,RelatedCustomerAccountId
,CustomerAccountRelationshipTypeId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,RelatedCustomerAccountNote
,SourceSystemCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT 
 SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,SRC.RelatedCustomerAccountId AS RelatedCustomerAccountId
,SRC.CustomerAccountRelationshipTypeId AS CustomerAccountRelationshipTypeId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp)) AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,NULL AS RelatedCustomerAccountNote
,'TRU' AS SourceSystemCode
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomerAccount SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomerAccount_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId
AND DELTA.RelatedCustomerAccountId = SRC.RelatedCustomerAccountId
AND DELTA.CustomerAccountRelationshipTypeId = SRC.CustomerAccountRelationshipTypeId
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
 WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT')

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomerAccount;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_RelatedCustomerAccount_DELTA;

END
GO
